'The face has in it' needs the pronoun on the preposition; Amal supplied فيو and he repeated il wajh fiyo.
Dual + my drops the n; Amal said No and named the rule.
grammar_errors.fix: No. We said for dual things or things that end in ain. ... So إيدين turns into إيدي.

grammar_errors.mistake: عيون takes a feminine plural colour; Amal prompted and supplied بنيات, he repeated ayun biniyat.

Amal named the rule: no b- after ممكن.

شمس is feminine; Amal recast منيحة.
